enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Axiomatic Burst 6: This weapon is an implement of law, dealing 6d6 Law damage on a successful hit to Chaotic enemies, and 1d6 Law damage on a critical hit to Chaotic enemies. This effect makes the weapon lawfully aligned.Chaotic characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Shocking Blast 6: This weapon arcs with deadly electricity, dealing 6d6 Electric damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Electric damage on a critical hit.
Riposte +6: This item enchants its user with incredible awareness and speed, granting a +6 Insight bonus to AC and to Saves.
